releases.title: Home Widgets + Editor Readability
important: TypeSync adds configurable note widgets on the Home page and new Android home-screen widgets for recently opened, frequently opened, and largest notes.
newFeatures: Added a swipeable Home Page Widgets carousel, with settings to choose the Upcoming, Recently opened, Frequently opened, and Largest notes views.
Added local note-open history, powering recently and frequently opened note lists without changing synced note data.
Added Android home-screen widgets for recently opened, frequently opened, and largest notes; the largest-notes widget can compare size, character count, or line count.
fixesImprovements: Refined note and folder background colors for calmer, more readable surfaces while preserving compatibility with saved legacy colors.
Improved contrast for note text and icons across selectable background colors.
notes: These notes summarize user-facing changes introduced after `v1.1.19` (2026-08-05).

releases.title: Calendar, Writing + Platform Reliability
important: TypeSync now offers a more capable writing and planning workflow, with built-in English and German spellcheck, date-range calendar selection, and broader editor keyboard controls.
newFeatures: Added English and German spellcheck with automatic language detection and a global option to disable spellchecking.
Added date-range selection in Calendar, making it easier to review events across a chosen period.
Added editor productivity controls including multi-selection, Shift-click selection, Alt+Arrow checklist reordering, a reset-text action, and code-block movement.
Added shared sync preferences for expanded attachments, so their state is available across devices.
Completed calendar todos now move to the bottom of the list.
fixesImprovements: Calendar now refreshes automatically after sync activity, and opening an event navigates to its correct position.
Improved Kanban block creation and editing reliability, and made checklist items start unchecked consistently.
Improved spellcheck performance in large notes and refined editor hover, selection, alignment, and search behavior.
Fixed subscription-plan refresh and admin entitlement granting, including Linux-specific payment-plan support.
Improved mobile authentication persistence/logout handling, file upload behavior, and Linux and iOS release builds.
notes: These notes summarize user-facing changes shipped after `v1.1.18` (2026-06-11); build-output and workflow-only commits are not listed individually.

releases.title: Offline Workflows + Smarter Editing
important: TypeSync now has a fuller offline workflow with more robust note conflict handling, restored live updates, and substantially fewer unnecessary sync network requests.
newFeatures: Added offline mode support for working without connectivity.
Added side-by-side note editing, including split-view polish, a custom desktop window flow, and shortcut help in Settings.
Added smart editor search plus search-and-replace for note editing.
Added subscription and billing groundwork, including RevenueCat link handling and cloud storage deletion support.
Added richer editing interactions such as strikethrough, checklist keyboard shortcuts, improved checklist behavior, and better checked-item hover details.
Added drag-and-drop folder move breadcrumbs and an undo action for file or folder moves.
Added timetable and calendar editing improvements, including todo rollover to the next day when unfinished.
fixesImprovements: Improved note update reliability with explicit conflict detection and resolution logic, plus diagnostic logging for sync and initialization flows.
Improved side-by-side editing stability, fixed jumping note updates, and resolved Kanban text-entry issues.
Reduced sync-related network traffic and re-enabled live note update sync behavior.
Improved marker color selection, toolkit organization, and natural resizing with two-finger scrolling gestures.
Fixed several Quill/editor regressions, Android build issues, Nix/Linux build problems, and analyzer cleanup.
Disabled checkout flows on Linux where billing support is not available yet.
notes: These notes summarize the work shipped after `v1.1.17` (2026-04-11). Local-only commits such as `local prop`, formatting, and build-output helper commits were not called out individually.

releases.title: Apple Platform Hardening + Import Upgrades
important: Apple-platform startup and login flow were hardened for release readiness, including safer Firebase initialization and iOS-specific widget fallback behavior.
newFeatures: Added broader Anytype import support for native export objects, including object-type folder mapping and native block conversion into TypeSync notes.
Added shared email validation across sign-in, registration, and email-link flows with a clearer typo hint for common `.con` mistakes.
Added Codemagic-based release automation plus required app metadata/assets for ownership verification and store publishing setup.
Added Apple Firebase app configuration files and project wiring for the updated app setup.
fixesImprovements: Fixed Upcoming widget data disappearing by reinitializing calendar, homework, and timetable providers against the active storage user and closing stale per-user boxes when needed.
Fixed iOS startup instability by avoiding unsupported iOS home widget bridge calls and by falling back cleanly when native Firebase app config is missing.
Improved auth failure diagnostics and surfaced a clearer invalid-credentials message during sign-in.
Fixed editor text formatting untoggle behavior and added unit coverage for the regression.
Refreshed app icons and publishing-related assets for release compatibility.
notes: These notes summarize the work shipped after the first `1.1.16` baseline commit (`9d61207` on 2026-04-09).

releases.title: Calendar Overhaul + Faster Add Flows
important: Calendar interaction was redesigned across Month, Week, 2 Weeks, and Year (KW) modes with smoother transitions and clearer selection behavior.
newFeatures: Added Year (KW) calendar mode with all 52/53 weeks visible at once and week-level event indicators.
Added event indicators on day cells and a persistent range-based event list below the calendar for every view mode.
Added optional event time (all-day support) and context-aware date preselection from the currently selected day or KW.
Added quick access calendar icon to the Files app bar near Settings.
Added one-tap "Add" flow from Files: Calendar/Homework now open directly into their add composer sheets.
Added per-device toolbar placement persistence so floating toolbar position can differ on phone, tablet, and desktop.
fixesImprovements: Fixed calendar day selection to toggle cleanly (tap again or tap empty space to deselect and clear the day filter).
Fixed Year (KW) layout overflow and removed internal KW grid scrolling.
Improved KW transition behavior to avoid overlapping old/new week numbers during mode changes.
Improved Upcoming widget behavior with clearer complete vs open actions and display-mode settings.
Fixed Settings "Version" entry to display build-aware app version info and separated it from the Changelog action.
notes: This release also aligns in-app version reporting with Flutter build-name/build-number values from `pubspec.yaml`.

releases.title: Structured Editors + Forward Compatibility
important: Files can now declare minimum supported app versions, and unsupported app builds show a clear upgrade message instead of silently failing.
newFeatures: Added TypeSync Kanban and Table embed blocks inside rich-text notes.
Added per-file cursor restore so editing resumes where you left off.
Added structured in-app changelog foundation and generation pipeline.
fixesImprovements: Added sync support for the new Kanban and Table embeds.
Improved editor open behavior to immediately allow typing for normal opens.
notes: This release entry is currently ahead of the latest git tag and reflects post-v1.1.14 work.
